'''Klex Fulgor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Look...we did all we could here. It all happened so quickly.|Klex Fulgor, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AA" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Inquisitor Klex Fulgor was based at the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:AA" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|accident]] took place in the research facility. The [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] that was studied there escaped containment and decimated most of the people in the area, turning them into cannibalistic [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. In response, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> The few people who survived the initial virus outbreak, including Fulgor,<ref name="SWG:AA" /> were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. The survivors established camps in order to to repel the regular assaults of the zombies and try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:MMR" />

[[File:Camp_Epsilon.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Camp Epsilon]] in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].]]
Klex Fulgor took shelter in [[Camp Epsilon]], the most unsafe camp since it was located in the courtyard of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility, the place where lived the most dangerous undeads.<ref name="SWG:AA" /> Other survivors in the camp at that time included the former prisoner [[Zsu Val]]<ref name="SWG:FWEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Forward Watch, Epsilon Camp|Dathomir}}</ref>, the technician [[Sogan Varga]],<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Deliver Radio|Dathomir}}</ref> the mechanic [[Nils Cridmeen]],<ref name="SWG:SP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Shuttle Parts|Dathomir}}</ref> and the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[GT-643]], [[KD-121]] and [[HX-138]].<ref name="SWG:FtS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find the Stormtroopers|Dathomir}}</ref>

At some point, the camp was visited by a group of spacers who pretended to be charged with a secret mission for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself. They needed to get access the Imperial Research Facility in order to recover an original sample of the Blackwing virus. Inquisitor Fulgor then accepted to help the spacers to find a way to access the facility.<ref name="SWG:AA" /> The spacers survived to their exploration of the research facility and finally came back to Camp Epsilon. In the meantime, Nils Cridmeen was able to repair a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] present in the camp. The refugees of Camp Epsilon and the spacers eventually escaped the Quarantine Zone altogether with the shuttle.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escape|Dathomir}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Klex Fulgor was fairly dismissive, telling a group of spacers he had no time for small talk. Despite this, however, his attention was grabbed at threats, as portrayed when the group of spacers threatened Klex that they had been sent by Darth Vader. He ended up cooperating with them after they showed an authorization code, unknowingly helping the Rebel Alliance. As a result [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Piett]] ensured that Klex would be punished for his insolence.<ref name="SWG:AA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Klex Fulgor was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Klex Fulgor was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
